CREATE TABLE plugin_local_sync_operations (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	instance_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	operation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	action VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	installed_id BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	document JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_plugin_local_operation UNIQUE (user_id, instance_id, operation_id)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_local_instance ON plugin_local_sync_operations (user_id, instance_id, action)

CREATE TABLE plugin_sync_outbox (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	instance_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	installed_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	operation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', 
	claim_token VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', 
	attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', 
	next_attempt_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	lease_until DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uniq_plugin_sync_event UNIQUE (user_id, instance_id, operation_id)
)ENGINE=InnoDB CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin
CREATE INDEX idx_plugin_sync_pending ON plugin_sync_outbox (state, next_attempt_at)
